'''Banyan Group Limited''' (formerly known as '''Banyan Tree Holdings''') is a [[Singapore]]an multinational hospitality brand that was established in 1994. It manages and [[land development|develops]] [[resort]]s, [[hotel chain|hotel]]s and [[spa]]s in Asia, Europe, North America, and Africa. The group comprises 12 global brands, including the flagship brand Banyan Tree. Currently, the Group operates more than 70 hotels and resorts, over 60 spas and galleries, and 14 branded residences in over 20 countries.<ref>{{cite web |title=Banyan Tree Group Unveils New HOMM Brand with First Location in Phuket, Thailand |url=https://www.banyantree.com/assets/2022-01/220110-banyan-tree-new-homm-brand-phuket.pdf |website=Banyan Tree Group |access-date=15 March 2022 |date=10 January 2022}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Banyan Tree Phuket Thailand.jpg|thumb|The first Banyan Tree location in [[Phuket]], [[Thailand]]]]
Banyan Tree started when founder [[Ho Kwon Ping]] and his wife [[Claire Chiang]] came across a plot of land while they were on holiday in Bang Tao Bay, on the western coast of [[Phuket Province|Phuket]] in the [[Andaman Sea]]. They purchased the land and embarked on a regeneration programme, reintroducing indigenous plants. Ten years later, in 1994, the first resort, Banyan Tree Phuket, was built.{{cn|date=April 2024}}

In 2000, the sister brand (second brand in the group) Angsana Resorts & Spa was launched in June with the opening of Angsana Bintan.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Net |first=Hospitality |date=2001-08-14 |title=Banyan Tree's 4th Angsana Resort & Spa Takes Root On The Eco-Island Of Ihuru In Maldives |url=https://www.hospitalitynet.org/news/4009864/banyan-trees-4th-angsana-resort-spa-takes-root-on-the-eco-island-of-ihuru-in-maldives |access-date=2026-04-27 |website=Hospitality Net |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=under-the-banyan-tree-25th-anniversary-issue.pdf |url=https://www.banyantree.com/assets/2021-11/under-the-banyan-tree-25th-anniversary-issue.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260427183934/https://www.banyantree.com/assets/2021-11/under-the-banyan-tree-25th-anniversary-issue.pdf |archive-date=2026-04-27 |access-date=2026-04-27 |website=www.banyantree.com}}</ref>

In 2009, Banyan Tree Global Foundation was created as part of Banyan Group Limited. In December 2016, Banyan Tree entered into a partnership with a French hospitality company, [[Accor]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Accor – Webzine |url=https://webzine-actionnaires.accor.com/12_2016/en/article/78/LONG-TERM_PARTNERSHIP_WITH_BANYAN_TREE.html |access-date=2025-02-14 |website=webzine-actionnaires.accor.com}}</ref> As part of the deal, Accor would invest €16 million to Banyan Tree in exchange for a 5% stake in the company, with the option to purchase an additional 5% stake.<ref name="Accor partnership">[https://press.accor.com/%e2%80%8bbanyan-tree-and-accorhotels-announce-strategic-partnership/?lang=en Banyan Tree and AccorHotels announce strategic partnership] Accor, 7 December 2016</ref>

In 2015, the Banyan Group launched its 4th brand Cassia (besides Banyan Tree, Angsana, Laguna) in outposts like Bintan and Phuket which focused on extended stays with amenities like fully equipped kitchens.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-07-16 |title=The curious case of Banyan Tree Hotels & Resorts and its relentless growth |url=https://www.thepeakmagazine.com.sg/lifestyle/banyan-tree-hotels-resorts-expansion-growth |access-date=2025-12-23 |website=PEAK Singapore |language=en-SG}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Banyan Tree's Cassia brand to make debut in Phuket |url=https://www.travelweekly.com/Travel-News/Hotel-News/Banyan-Tree-Cassia-brand-to-make-debut-in-Phuket |access-date=2026-04-27 |website=www.travelweekly.com |language=en}}</ref> In October 2015, the Banyan Group launched its 5th brand Dhawa<ref>{{Cite web |title=Banyan Tree launches Dhawa brand |url=https://www.travelmole.com/news/banyan-tree-launches-dhawa-brand/ |access-date=2026-04-28 |website=TravelMole |language=en-US}}</ref>, and the First Dhawa opens in Cayo Santa Maria, Cuba, in December 2016<ref>{{Cite news |last=Oates |first=Greg |date=2016-12-22 |title=Banyan Tree Moves Into Cuba With Four Hotels Including New Dhawa Brand |url=https://skift.com/2016/12/22/banyan-tree-moves-into-cuba-with-four-hotels-including-new-dhawa-brand/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240912081629/https://skift.com/2016/12/22/banyan-tree-moves-into-cuba-with-four-hotels-including-new-dhawa-brand/ |archive-date=2024-09-12 |access-date=2026-04-28 |work=Skift |language=en-US}}</ref>.

On 26 November 2025, Banyan Group and [[Mandai Wildlife Group]] officially opened Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree—Banyan’s 100th property and its first in Singapore—situated within the Mandai Wildlife Reserve as the first resort located inside a major wildlife and nature destination in the city. <ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.straitstimes.com/paid-press-releases/grand-opening-of-mandai-rainforest-resort-by-banyan-tree-and-rainforest-festival-20251127|title=Grand Opening of Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree and Rainforest Festival|date=27 Nov 2025}}</ref> This is also Banyan Group's 100th property overall.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Tan |first=Elysia |date=2025-11-26 |title=Banyan Group hopes its new Mandai resort showcases Singapore’s biodiversity, strength in conservation |url=https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/singapore/banyan-group-hopes-its-new-mandai-resort-showcases-singapores-biodiversity-strength-conservation |access-date=2025-12-23 |website=The Business Times |language=en}}</ref> 

Scheduled to open in early 2026, Ubuyu will be Banyan Group’s first safari resort, located in Tanzania’s Ruaha National Park. The eco-luxury retreat will feature six artisan-crafted villas inspired by Maasai architecture, overlooking the Great Ruaha River and blending into the surrounding savannah where wildlife roams freely.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.forbes.com.au/life/stays/forbes-travel-guides-most-anticipated-hotel-openings-of-2026/|title=Forbes Travel Guide’s most anticipated hotel openings of 2026|date=Nov 10, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.luxurytraveladvisor.com/hotels/banyan-group-open-100th-property-singapore|title=Banyan Group to Open 100th Property in Singapore|date=July 15, 2025 |author=Newsdesk |website=luxurytraveladvisor.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.banyantree.com/escape/tanzania/ubuyu-a-banyan-tree-escape|title=Ubuyu, A Banyan Tree Escape}}</ref>

==Brands==
{{As of|2023|July}}, the company operates 70 resorts and hotels. Under its management are also 63 spas, 64 retail galleries, and three championship golf courses in 23 countries.<ref>[https://www.ttgasia.com/2023/07/07/banyan-tree-group-hits-portfolio-milestone-with-more-asian-openings/ ttgasia.com]</ref> Banyan Tree currently markets its properties under ten brands, including Banyan Tree, Angsana, Laguna, Cassia, Dhawa, Garrya, Homm, Banyan Tree Escape, Banyan Tree Veya, and Folio.<ref>{{cite web |title=Hotels & Resorts - Banyan Tree |url=https://www.banyantree.com/hotels |website=www.banyantree.com |access-date=15 March 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=The curious case of Banyan Tree Hotels & Resorts and its relentless growth |url=https://www.thepeakmagazine.com.sg/gourmet-travel/banyan-tree-hotels-resorts-expansion-growth/ |website=The Peak |access-date=28 July 2023}}</ref>
